t: For expenses incurred as a result of the American Agricultural Movement demonstration in the District of Columbia (D.C. Code 1–827(b)), $2,565,000.

fable.w: This is a pure appropriation to cover costs arising from a past demonstration. The tempting reading is that a public demonstration by an outside group amounts to participation, but a protest is not a process by which the federal government consults or coordinates with outsiders before a decision. The section creates no comment period, hearing, advisory body, rulemaking, or right to sue.

It does not mandate consultation, coordination, or any interactive process with the demonstrators before a decision is made.
